_note: VulcanCyber v1: a cybersecurity eval suite curated from real merged OSS PRs whose fixes ALL merged after 2026-06-01 (post current model training cutoffs, incl. Opus 5's May 2026 cutoff), so the suite is contamination-clean for today's frontier models. Defensive posture only: every task is 'here is vulnerable/insufficient code, produce the fix', graded by the PR's own deterministic security regression tests (grader:tests, no LLM judge). A mix of (A) vulnerability fixes and (B) security-tooling PRs across Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go. EVERY task records upstream_merged, so when a newer model's cutoff moves past these dates the clean subset is a query, not archaeology -- do not assume this suite stays clean indefinitely. Tasks are admitted only after validation (gold=1.0, base fails fail_to_pass, deterministic x3 via scripts/validate_tasks.py --sandbox docker) and difficulty measurement (Sonnet 5 + Opus 5, repeat>=3). This manifest is populated as tasks are admitted; see CANDIDATES.md for the sourcing worklog and CHARTER.md for the discipline.
